overview_description.description:
CoreCare is the leading AI-powered workflow platform helping Post-Acute and Long-Term Care (PALTC) providers achieve operational excellence. Trusted by 1,000+ locations nationwide, CoreCare increases admissions, optimizes reimbursement rates, improves collection metrics, and reduces administrative burdens—all on one intuitive platform.

At the heart of CoreCare is Collaborative Revenue Management, which unites essential data and teams on a shared platform. Our approach empowers employees—regardless of skill or tenure—to perform like experts from day one and collaborate with their peers on important work while giving management unmatched visibility into performance.

CoreCare replaces error-prone spreadsheets and fragmented portals with streamlined workflows that drive measurable results. Backed by Y Combinator and trusted by top providers, CoreCare redefines how teams work and sets a new standard for AI in long-term care.

product.name: CoreCare Pre-Admit
product.description: A tool for skilled nursing facilities to perform instant clinical and financial verifications on referrals, ensuring compliance and readiness for admission.

product.name: CoreCare Admit
product.description: A platform to manage and track admission tasks such as PASRR forms, level of care determinations, Medicaid applications, and authorizations in one place.

product.name: CoreCare Clinical
product.description: A system that tracks MDS assessments, state forms, and clinical indicators to support accurate and timely billing in long-term care.

product.name: CoreCare Revenue
product.description: A solution that automates eligibility checks, detects benefits changes, and monitors Medicaid renewals to ensure clean claims and faster approvals.
